newsitem.title: INDIA: India firm confirms Nomura Securities seeking stake.
newsitem.headline: India firm confirms Nomura Securities seeking stake.

text.p: India's UTI Securities confirmed on Friday that Japan's Nomura Securities Co Ltd was interested in buying a 40 percent equity stake in the state-run mutual fund firm.
"They have shown interest in buying a 40 percent stake in UTI Securities," M.K. Khanna, managing director of UTI Securities told Reuters by telephone from Bombay.
UTI Securities is a stockbroking and investment company set up by the state-run Unit Trust of India in November 1994, the country's largest mutual fund.
M.K. Khanna, managing director of UTI Securities, told Reuters by telephone from Bombay that the company has a paid-up capital of 300 million rupees ($8.4 million) ($1=35.8 rupees)
